title: 'attack <name>' is offered as a standing menu option against companions already traveling in the party (e.g. 'attack Vell with hunting knife', 'attack Tamsin with hunting knife') with no warning, even mid-conversation, inviting an accidental hostile action against your own ally.
where: The Last Light Inn / The Forge — menu options while Vell/Tamsin are present
